 Karnataka vs UP SMAT Match Live 
 Where to Watch Karnataka vs UP SMAT Match Live? Streaming Details Revealed
 Vishal Bhawani Published -  Nov 16, 2026, 04:00 AM 3 min comment Add on As Preferred Source Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Karnataka will face Uttar Pradesh in an Elite Group A clash of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2026 on Monday, November 16. The match will take place at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai. The first ball is scheduled for 11:00 AM IST.
 Karnataka enter this contest after defeating Bengal by 19 runs in their opening match. Uttar Pradesh, meanwhile, suffered a six-wicket defeat against Rajasthan. Here's everything you need to know about the Karnataka vs UP live streaming and match details.
 Where to Watch Karnataka vs UP SMAT Match Live?
 Cricket fans in India can watch the Karnataka vs UP SMAT 2026 live streaming on JioHotstar. The streaming platform will provide live coverage through its app and website. A subscription is required to access the Karnataka vs UP SMAT live stream.
 However, fans can follow toss updates and ball-by-ball scores through the official BCCI Match Centre. Sportsdunia Live Cricket Score will also provide match updates and tournament-related information.

 Karnataka vs Uttar Pradesh Match Preview: Players to Watch
 Karnataka began their Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy campaign with an impressive 19-run victory over Bengal. Batting first, they scored 184 runs, with Karun Nair leading the innings with 53 runs off 35 balls. Praveen Dubey also made an unbeaten 30 off 15 balls. Abhilash Shetty picked up four wickets for 26 runs, while Vijaykumar Vyshak claimed three wickets. 
 Uttar Pradesh will look to bounce back after losing their opening match against Rajasthan by six wickets. Sameer Rizvi was their top performer with an unbeaten 74, while Siddharth Yadav contributed 37 runs. However, Rajasthan chased down the target of 172 in just 15.4 overs. 
 For Karnataka, Manish Pandey , Abhinav Manohar and Karun Nair will be important players with the bat. Their bowling attack will rely on Vidhwath Kaverappa, Vijaykumar Vyshak and Abhilash Shetty, subject to final team selection. 
 Uttar Pradesh will depend on Sameer Rizvi, Aryan Juyal and Abhishek Goswami to deliver with the bat. Bhuvneshwar Kumar , Mohsin Khan, Shivam Mavi and Yash Dayal are among the bowling options to watch. Both teams will be eager to secure a win and improve their position in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy.
